modelDescription: An out-of-the-box rifle for hunts and target shooters alike. The Hogue Rifle features a Hogue pillar bedded overmolded stock for superior fit, function and accuracy. The combination of the high precision Howa 1500 and the ergonomic Hogue OverMolded stock is a perfect blend for a lightweight, entry level match or sporting rifle you can depend on. The Howa 1500 brings with it, cold hammer forged barrel, steel forged bolt and receiver, HACT 2-stage trigger, and a 3-position safety.
